subject: Initial Org Gate & Admin Seed - Kickoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@clearwell.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial Org Gate & Admin Seed - Kickoff

Hi Alice,

Thanks for signing the order — excited to get ClearWell across the finish line. To make the first week predictable, we want to seed your org with the admin roles, create the initial project namespaces, and provision API keys so your engineering team can run smoke tests right away. High-level plan: 

- Day 0 (today): kickoff + confirm SSO choice and list of initial admins.
- Day 1: create org skeleton (projects/namespaces), seed 2 admin API keys (one for infra, one for CI).
- Day 2: invite users (dev, observer, billing roles) and validate JWT/API workflows with your QA app.
- Day 3: handoff runbook and rotate seeded keys to customer-managed secrets.

Attachments: I attached an implementation checklist and a short API key seeding guide.

Quick asks from us to you: 
1) Confirm the two admin user emails you want in the initial admin group (recommended: 1 infra engineer + 1 security contact).
2) Do you want Redwood to seed keys in your project or provide a service account template for you to generate? (We can do either; seeding is fastest.)
3) Any regulatory controls we should enable immediately (data residency, audit-only mode)?

Proposed 30-min kickoff now at 11:00 PT if that works for your team. If not, suggest a time and we adjust.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Implementation_Checklist_v1.xlsx, API-Key-Seeding-Guide.pdf
From: Alice Monroe <alice@clearwell.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ClearWell Ops <clearwell-ops@clearwell.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial Org Gate & Admin Seed - Kickoff

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear plan. 11:00 PT works for our ops folks. A few clarifications: 

- Initial admins: myself (alice@clearwell.ai) and Marco Li (marco.li@clearwell.ai, engineering manager).
- We prefer Redwood to seed the initial keys so our CI team can validate quickly; we'll rotate to our vault afterward.
- We like SSO (SAML) enabled but can defer SCIM sync until after the first week.
- Please enable audit-only logs for token issuance for the first 14 days.

Also: are there any quota or rate-limit defaults we should be aware of for smoke tests? We expect a few thousand tokens per day in the first run.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Alice
Alice Monroe
Head of Platform, ClearWell Health
alice@clearwell.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Initial Org Gate & Admin Seed - Kickoff

On Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 10:25 AM Alice Monroe <alice@clearwell.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear plan. 11:00 PT works for our ops folks. A few clarifications: 
> 
> - Initial admins: myself (alice@clearwell.ai) and Marco Li (marco.li@clearwell.ai, engineering manager).
> - We prefer Redwood to seed the initial keys so our CI team can validate quickly; we'll rotate to our vault afterward.
> - We like SSO (SAML) enabled but can defer SCIM sync until after the first week.
> - Please enable audit-only logs for token issuance for the first 14 days.
> 
> Also: are there any quota or rate-limit defaults we should be aware of for smoke tests? We expect a few thousand tokens per day in the first run.

Thanks Alice — counterpoints and operational notes: 
- Role matrix (quick): Admin (org-level, can create keys & projects) -> alice@clearwell.ai, marco.li@clearwell.ai; Developer -> devs@clearwell.ai group (invite later); Billing -> finance@clearwell.ai; Observer -> security-monitoring@clearwell.ai. I'll attach a one-page role mapping excerpt to the ticket.
- Seeding keys: we can seed two admin keys per your ask. We'll mark them with tags: CLW-admin-seed-1 (infra), CLW-admin-seed-2 (CI). Please confirm if CI key should be scoped to "project:ci" only (recommended).
- Rate limits: default hosted tier has a soft rate-limit of 500 rps per org; for initial smoke tests a few thousand tokens/day is fine. For steady-state tests please let us know expected concurrency and we can propose a dedicated quota or burst policy.
- Audit-only logs: I'll enable token-issuance audit mode for 14 days and send the retention settings to ClearWell.

I propose the internal assignments for the kickoff: Aditya to run the call and seed keys, Tessa to configure SSO with our identity team if they need help, Vivek to confirm rate-limit policy and escalation path.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@clearwell.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial Org Gate & Admin Seed - Kickoff

Great — thanks for the quick replies and confirmation, Alice. To summarize and confirm next steps: 

1) Kickoff 11:00 PT today (calendar invite sent).
2) Seed two admin API keys: alice@clearwell.ai (org-admin) and CI-scoped key CLW-admin-seed-2 (scoped to project:ci).
3) Enable SAML SSO (basic) now; SCIM deferred. Tessa will follow up on exact IdP metadata after the call.
4) Audit-only token issuance logs enabled for 14 days.
5) Rate limits: initial smoke test within hosted defaults; we re-evaluate if you need >500 rps sustained. Vivek will be the escalation owner for any throttling.

Deliverables and owners: 
- Implementation_Checklist_v1.xlsx (attached) — Monica (owner) — will track invites and key rotation.
- API-Key-Seeding-Guide.pdf (attached) — Aditya (owner) — will perform the seeding and post keys to secure channel for ClearWell to pull.
- SAML setup — Tessa (owner) — will request IdP metadata and confirm SSO test.

If everything looks good I like to close out the kickoff ticket after the call and open a short 7-day implementation sprint board in our project workspace (link to be posted to HubSpot).

Thanks again — see you on the call.

Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
